title: Omgång 12 · vila B · blick ned och ett litet leende
summary: Gör en vilofilm av Paow: hon sitter still, och filmen börjar och slutar på ankare 1.

step.label: Vila, samma bild först och sist

reference.why: WAN 3 tar ingen referensfilm tillsammans med första och sista bild.

prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. She starts and ends exactly as in the first frame, and holds still for the last half second. She blinks and lowers her eyes to the felt in front of her, then lifts them to the camera, and a small smile comes and goes: her lips stay together as the corners of her mouth lift a little. Her head tilts a little to one side with the smile and comes back. Her hands rest on the felt.
